integrity: All proofs and checks concern the claims as written. No independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact diameter and uniqueness theorem holds for positive real increments and the canonical Euclidean coordinate realization. The second-largest distinct squared vertex distance and multiplicity are proved for unit increments, n>=3, not arbitrary increments. Results are not invariant under general affine maps. Numerical checks are finite and do not certify the infinite assertion; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact Euclidean diameters and second-distance layers of Pitman–Stanley polytopes
